title: Essentially smooth local factorization descends through larger quotients
statement: Let R, C, T be commutative rings with C and T R-algebras, γ:C→T an R-algebra map, q a prime of T and J an ideal of R. Put R₀=R/J, C₀=C/JC, T₀=T/JT. Suppose γ₀:C₀→T₀ is an R₀-algebra map commuting with the quotient maps and q₀ is a prime of T₀ whose inverse image is q. Put Q=R_(q∩R), L=T_q with their induced algebra map. Suppose I⊆JQ and K⊆JL are ideals with IL⊆K, D is a compatible Q- and Q/I-algebra essentially smooth over Q/I, and f:Q⊗_R C→D and g:D→L/K are Q-algebra maps whose composite is the canonical tensor map. Put P=(R₀)_(q₀∩R₀) and L₀=(T₀)_q₀. Then there exists a P-algebra E essentially smooth over P and P-algebra maps F:P⊗_(R₀)C₀→E and G:E→L₀ whose composite is the canonical tensor map induced by γ₀. With R:Type u and C:Type v, D and E have carriers in Type(max u v), independently of the universe of T.

proof.text: Use the equality lifting q₀ to construct ρ:Q→P and τ:L→L₀ with Localization.localRingHom. Check formulas on images of R and T using localRingHom_to_map. I⊆JQ and K⊆JL show I⊆ker ρ and K⊆ker τ. Localization ring-homomorphism extensionality proves compatibility with Q→L and P→L₀. Quotient.lift constructs Q/I→P and L/K→L₀, making D→L₀ a Q/I-algebra homomorphism.

proof.text: Set E=P⊗_(Q/I)D. TensorProduct.lift constructs G:E→L₀. The composite C→Q⊗_R C→D→E sends a base element x to its image under R→R/J→P→E, hence kills JC. Quotient.lift descends it to C/JC, and TensorProduct.lift constructs F:P⊗_(R/J)(C/JC)→E. Tensor induction reduces the composite equation to pure tensors; quotient surjectivity then reduces to c∈C, where it follows from gf and the quotient compatibility equation for γ₀.

proof.text: The private, proved essentiallySmooth_baseChange lemma presents D as the localization of a smooth Q/I-algebra S. Transport the S-algebra structure to D using the inverse presentation equivalence, and transport the localization instance by IsLocalization.isLocalization_iff_of_ringEquiv. Algebra.Smooth.baseChange makes P⊗_(Q/I)S smooth. IsLocalization.tensorProductEquivOfMapIncludeRight exhibits E as its localization at the image of the multiplicative subset. All carriers lie in Type(max u v), so this is the required EssentiallySmooth presentation without a universe change.

theorem essentiallySmooth_localized_quotient_factorization
    {R : Type u} {C : Type v} {T : Type w}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing C] [CommRing T] [Algebra R C] [Algebra R T]
    (γ : C →ₐ[R] T) (q : PrimeSpectrum T) (J : Ideal R)
    (γ₀ : (C ⧸ J.map (algebraMap R C)) →ₐ[R ⧸ J]
      (T ⧸ J.map (algebraMap R T)))
    (q₀ : PrimeSpectrum (T ⧸ J.map (algebraMap R T)))
    (hγ : γ₀.toRingHom.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.map (algebraMap R C))) =
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.map (algebraMap R T))).comp γ.toRingHom)
    (hq : PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J.map (algebraMap R T))) q₀ = q)
    (hfactor :
      let Q := Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.under R)
      let L := Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal
      letI := Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver (q.asIdeal.under R) q.asIdeal
      let JQ := J.map (algebraMap R Q)
      let JL := (J.map (algebraMap R T)).map (algebraMap T L)
      ∃ (I : Ideal Q) (K : Ideal L),
        I ≤ JQ ∧ K ≤ JL ∧ I.map (algebraMap Q L) ≤ K ∧
        ∃ (D : Type (max u v)) (_ : CommRing D) (_ : Algebra Q D)
          (_ : Algebra (Q ⧸ I) D) (_ : IsScalarTower Q (Q ⧸ I) D),
          EssentiallySmooth (Q ⧸ I) D ∧
          ∃ (f : Q ⊗[R] C →ₐ[Q] D) (g : D →ₐ[Q] L ⧸ K),
            g.comp f = Algebra.TensorProduct.lift (Algebra.ofId Q (L ⧸ K))
              ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R K).comp
                ((IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R T L).comp γ))
              (fun _ _ ↦ Commute.all _ _)) :
    let R₀ := R ⧸ J
    let C₀ := C ⧸ J.map (algebraMap R C)
    let T₀ := T ⧸ J.map (algebraMap R T)
    let P := Localization.AtPrime (q₀.asIdeal.under R₀)
    let L₀ := Localization.AtPrime q₀.asIdeal
    letI := Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver (q₀.asIdeal.under R₀) q₀.asIdeal
    ∃ (E : Type (max u v)) (_ : CommRing E) (_ : Algebra P E),
      EssentiallySmooth P E ∧
      ∃ (f : P ⊗[R₀] C₀ →ₐ[P] E) (g : E →ₐ[P] L₀),
        g.comp f = Algebra.TensorProduct.lift (Algebra.ofId P L₀)
          ((IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R₀ T₀ L₀).comp γ₀)
          (fun _ _ ↦ Commute.all _ _)
